info: Threaded fastener with a sharp point designed to grip wood fibers tightly.
Mechanical fastener with a threaded shaft, usually secured with a nut.
Six-sided internal threaded fastener that mates with a bolt to clamp parts together.
Thin plate with a hole used to distribute the load of a threaded fastener.
Wall plug inserted into a drilled hole to allow screws to hold securely in drywall or masonry.
A straight, solid cylindrical bar used as a structural support, linkage, or guide.
A relatively long rod that is threaded on both ends or along its entire length, often called a stud.
A type of fastener with a threaded hole, used in conjunction with a mating bolt to fasten parts together.
A short threaded fastener typically used to join metal parts together by screwing into a tapped hole.
A tapered screw designed specifically for wood with a coarser thread to prevent stripping.
A joint or coupling connecting rigid rods whose axes are inclined to each other, allowing rotary motion.
General term for threaded sleeves placed into a material to provide a durable internal thread.
Heat-set or brass threaded inserts pressed into 3D printed plastic components to provide strong threads.
Unthreaded tubes or blocks used to create clearance or hold a precise distance between two components.
Mechanical components that reduce friction between moving parts, typically supporting rotating shafts.
